quote_text: Most members who ask us about stock software fear the changeover, not the fee. What matters is whether a firm of eleven people can get its own data out. Here it can.
author: Dr. Ingrid Wallnöfer
role: Chair of the digitalisation committee, Wholesale Association

image.alternative: Portrait of Dr. Ingrid Wallnöfer, a woman in her sixties with grey hair pinned up and a patterned scarf.
